【turn860344search2】 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: today; With that in mind, we spent some time fixing the Hatch Control System to unlock our two Escape Pods – we were one step closer from escaping this death trap. ...   * Hatch Control System: Lock or unlock 1 Escape Pod. ... Nemesis is a semi-cooperative game with multiple potential winners.
  * Surgery: Scan all Contamination cards and remove Infected ones. Remove any Larva on your board. Suffer 1 Light Wound and automatically pass.

### Additional Rooms “2” (5 used per game)

  * Airlock Control: Initiate lock procedure in a yellow room without destroyed doors. If doors remain closed until end of Player Phase, everything in that room dies.
  * Cabins: If starting turn here without Intruders, draw 1 additional Action card (hand size 6).
  * Canteen: Heal 1 Light Wound. Option to Scan hand Contamination cards and remove non-infected ones.
  * Command Center: Choose 1 Room: open or close any doors in connected Corridors.
  * Engine Control Room: Check the status of all 3 Engines.
  * Hatch Control System: Lock or unlock 1 Escape Pod.
  * Monitoring Room: Secretly check 1 unexplored Room tile and its Exploration token.
  * Room Covered with Slime: Gain a Slime marker upon entering. Cannot Search here.
  * Shower Room: Discard Slime marker. Option to Scan hand Contamination cards.

### Special Rooms

  * Cockpit: Check Coordinates card OR change the Destination marker on the track.
  * Engines 1, 2, 3: Check the top Engine token OR Repair/Break the Engine. (At least 2 working engines are needed for a safe jump).
  * Hibernatorium: Enter hibernation once the Time Track reaches a blue space (perform Noise roll).

### Escape Pods

Pods hold up to 2 Characters. Once inside, choose to launch immediately (leaving the game safely) or wait for other crew members. Entering an Escape Pod requires an Unlocked pod and a successful Noise roll.

Image: Escape Pod StatesEscape Pod States

### Intruder Weakness Cards

Three face-down cards are placed on the Intruder board during setup. Characters discover them by analyzing Objects in the Laboratory:

  1. Character Corpse
  2. Intruder Egg
  3. Intruder Carcass

Revealed Weaknesses provide permanent advantages to all players against Intruders.

Image: Intruder Board and Weakness SlotsIntruder Board and Weakness Slots

The game ends immediately when one of the following conditions is met:

  * Time runs out: The Time marker reaches the final red space of the Time Track. The ship jumps into hyperspace; all Characters not in hibernation die from g-force. Intruders are unharmed.
  * Ship destruction: The Self-Destruct marker reaches the skull space, OR a 9th Fire marker is needed, OR a 9th Malfunction marker is needed. The ship explodes/loses hull integrity; all Characters and Intruders die.
  * No active Characters left: The last alive, non-hibernating Character dies, hibernates, or launches in an Escape Pod. If Self-Destruct was active, resolve its final space; otherwise move the Time marker to the final space and resolve hyperspace jump.

### Victory Check

If at least 1 Character survived, perform the following checks in order:

  1. Engines Check: Reveal the top Engine tokens of all 3 Engines. If 2 or 3 are Damaged, the ship explodes: all hibernating Characters and Intruders die.
  2. Coordinates Check: Reveal the Coordinates card and check the Destination marker. If not headed to Earth, all Characters asleep in the Hibernatorium die (unless their objective was Quarantine to Mars). The ship is not destroyed.
  3. Contamination Check: Each alive Character (hibernating or escaped) checks Contamination:
     * Scan all Contamination cards in your deck, discard pile, and hand.
     * If at least 1 card is “INFECTED” (or if you have a Larva on your board), shuffle all cards (Action and Contamination) and draw the top 4 cards. If any Contamination card appears, the Character dies. Otherwise, they survive.
  4. Objective Check: Each surviving Character reveals their chosen Objective card to confirm if all requirements were successfully met.

### Ending the Game Before Other Players

Characters who launch in an Escape Pod, hibernate, or die can no longer take actions and spectate. The first player whose Character dies may optionally play as the Intruder.
